subject: Saturday ensemble slot confirmed

Jessica,

Confirming the Saturday 10am ensemble slot is locked in the fall schedule. I'll update the website listing today.

One thing — Marcus Bell asked about the winter recital signup deadline. I told him end of September. Does that still work?

Claire

subject: Re: 5th Anniversary Showcase — one question
snippet: Got the signed agreement back, thank you. One question about load-in...
body:
Jessica,

Got the signed agreement back, thank you. One question — the load-in time on the contract says 5pm Friday, but I had 4pm in my notes from our call. Can you confirm which it is? I want the room ready for the quartet.

Also, Tomoko mentioned she might need a sub for the late set. Do you want to approve any subs, or should the band handle it?

Thanks,
Danny
The Phoenix

subject: Re: Saturday ensemble slot confirmed
snippet: Yes, September 30 works for the recital signup. I'll send all the parents...

Yes, September 30 works for the recital signup. I'll send all the parents a note next week with the details.

Can you also add the Saturday ensemble to the fall enrollment page? I'll update the calendar on the band site tonight.

Jessica

subject: Kids this weekend — pickup time?

Hey,

Are you dropping Sofia and Dante off Saturday morning before rehearsal, or should I pick them up? We're doing the Nelson-Atkins in the afternoon and want to plan lunch around it.

Also — your mom got showcase tickets, she's thrilled. Can she come backstage after?

Ellen
